pretrend_log_customs_unit_value_ref3.caveat: diagonal-only approximation; ignores covariance between event-time coefficients, so the p-value is indicative rather than an exact joint test. Statistical significance of a pre-coefficient is not by itself grounds to reject the design in a large panel; read it together with the relative magnitude.

sutva_control_group.description: Comparison of treatment estimates under a diversion-contaminated control group versus a control group restricted to treated-country flows of never-treated products.
sutva_control_group.interpretation: A gap indicates that third-country suppliers of treated products respond to the policy, so they are not valid controls. In trade settings this is the rule, not the exception.
